532: Click on your answer to each question to work through the flowchart, or click on “Play the conversation”.
541: I see someone in emotional distress.
542: Can I approach them respectfully at this moment? If not: I wait and stay available. If so: I approach (simple and direct): “Would you like me to stay with you?” / “Can I stay with you?”
543: Does the person want to talk? If not: I respect that and say “I’m here if you need me”. If so: I listen with empathy (no interrupting, no judging, no immediate solutions).
544: What is most needed right now? Activated body: calm down (breathing, a pause, space). Intense emotion: presence and validation. Confusion: listen and help organise. Practical need: direct support.
545: Do they need additional support? If so: help link them to people or services. Afterwards, or if not: reinforce availability, do not leave them isolated (if necessary), resume at the person’s pace.
